# Orca release compatibility fixture

`orca-v1.4.230-status.ts.txt` is the actual managed Pi status extension generated by Orca v1.4.230, commit `b2879bd5aaac5d27c101ccf4171faa25d9f0bb1e`.

- Generator: <https://github.com/stablyai/orca/blob/v1.4.230/src/main/pi/agent-status-extension-source.ts>
- Invocation: `getPiAgentStatusExtensionSource("pi")`
- Generated bytes SHA-256: `cdc68c84c56b6524bdbcc7036cab36b352a43c7b794a72ce046a5b8bf8aa1152`
- Attribution and MIT license: [ORCA-LICENSE](ORCA-LICENSE)

The compatibility test copies this source into a temporary `.ts` module and loads it using Pi's installed Jiti loader. It exercises both factory orders and overlapping Herder/workflow holds against the actual released reporter. Hook HTTP is mocked; no Orca app, credentials, or network access is required. The `.txt` suffix prevents accidental Pi extension discovery.

When updating the supported release, regenerate the fixture from the exact tagged generator, retain its attribution, update this provenance and digest, and run `npm run test:orca-bridge`. Do not silently replace it with a simplified reporter mock.
